description: In October, the National Education Association published their 2026 legislative scorecard and voter guide. Don House and Don Giguere were the only two candidates representing Belmont, Tilton, and Sanbornton that were endorsed by the NEA. If you value education, you should vote for a candidate that shares that view. Here is the list of NEA-NH endorsed candidates as well as the scorecard of how current Belknap County candidates voted on educational issues.

title: National Education Association-NH endorses Don House
